### Too Big Not To Fail
Author: Jared C. Wilson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/too-big-not-to-fail-2/
Passage: Genesis 11:4
Points:
- The human craving for renown and attention is rooted in fear and deep-seated insecurity.
- People assume that accumulating size, stature, and strength creates lasting security.
- Building monuments to our own name contributes directly to the collapse and dispersion we fear.
- Growing larger and prouder in human terms simply makes us more vulnerable to falling.
- True significance and spiritual strength come from humility, letting Christ increase while self decreases.

### When God Mercifully Ruins Our Plans
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/when-god-mercifully-ruins-our-plans
Passage: Genesis 11:4-8
Points:
- Human beings often invest immense effort into pursuits aimed purely at making a name for themselves.
- God must condescend just to view human achievements, exposing the vanity of human grandeur.
- Confusing language and scattering humanity was a mercy designed to restrain the devastating power of unchecked pride.
- Painful setbacks and ruined ambitions in our lives often serve God's gracious and redemptive purposes.
- God opposes our pride so that we are freed from empty self-glory to find lasting joy in Jesus Christ.
